title: "Cercle de Mohr interactif"
engine: marimo
pyproject: |
  requires-python = ">=3.10"
  dependencies = ["numpy", "matplotlib"]
---

Entrez les composantes du tenseur des contraintes (en MPa).
Le premier chargement peut prendre quelques secondes.

```python {.marimo}
import marimo as mo
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```python {.marimo}
sxx = mo.ui.number(start=-300, stop=300, step=1, value=40, label="σxx (MPa)")
syy = mo.ui.number(start=-300, stop=300, step=1, value=-40, label="σyy (MPa)")
sxy = mo.ui.number(start=-300, stop=300, step=1, value=30, label="σxy (MPa)")
mo.hstack([sxx, syy, sxy], justify="start")
```

## Résultats

```python {.marimo}
S = np.array([[sxx.value, sxy.value],
              [sxy.value, syy.value]], dtype=float)
c = (S[0, 0] + S[1, 1]) / 2
R = np.sqrt((S[0, 0] - S[1, 1])**2 / 4 + S[0, 1]**2)
s1, s2 = c + R, c - R
theta = 0.5 * np.arctan2(2 * S[0, 1], S[0, 0] - S[1, 1])
e1 = np.array([np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)])
e2 = np.array([-np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)])

mo.md(f"""
| Grandeur | Valeur |
|:--|:--|
| Centre du cercle (contrainte moyenne) | {c:.2f} MPa |
| Rayon du cercle = τ<sub>max</sub> | {R:.2f} MPa |
| Contrainte principale σ<sub>I</sub> | {s1:.2f} MPa |
| Contrainte principale σ<sub>II</sub> | {s2:.2f} MPa |
| Angle entre x et la direction I | {np.degrees(theta):.2f}° |
| Direction principale I | ({e1[0]:.3f} ; {e1[1]:.3f}) |
| Direction principale II | ({e2[0]:.3f} ; {e2[1]:.3f}) |
""")
```

## Cercle de Mohr

```python {.marimo}
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
_t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 300)
_ax.plot(c + R * np.cos(_t), R * np.sin(_t), color="#5c8037", lw=3)
_ax.plot([S[1, 1], S[0, 0]], [S[0, 1], -S[0, 1]], "ko-")
_ax.plot([s1, s2], [0, 0], "ro")
_ax.plot(c, 0, "o", mfc="w", mec="k")
_ax.text(S[0, 0], -S[0, 1], "  X (facette x)")
_ax.text(S[1, 1], S[0, 1], "  Y (facette y)")
_ax.text(s1, 0, "  σI", color="red")
_ax.text(s2, 0, "  σII", color="red")
_ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.8)
_ax.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.8)
_ax.set_aspect("equal")
_ax.grid(True)
_ax.set_xlabel(r"$\sigma_n$ (MPa)")
_ax.set_ylabel(r"$\tau_n$ (MPa)")
_fig
```

## Directions principales dans le plan (x, y)

```python {.marimo}
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
for _v, _col, _lab in [(e1, "red", f"Direction I (σI = {s1:.1f} MPa)"),
                       (e2, "blue", f"Direction II (σII = {s2:.1f} MPa)")]:
    _ax.quiver([0, 0], [0, 0], [_v[0], -_v[0]], [_v[1], -_v[1]],
               angles="xy", scale_units="xy", scale=1, color=_col, label=_lab)
_a = 0.4
_carre = np.array([[-_a, -_a], [_a, -_a], [_a, _a], [-_a, _a], [-_a, -_a]])
_rot = np.array([[np.cos(theta), -np.sin(theta)],
                 [np.sin(theta),  np.cos(theta)]])
_el = _carre @ _rot.T
_ax.plot(_el[:, 0], _el[:, 1], "--", color="gray", label="Élément principal")
_ax.axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.5, ls="--")
_ax.axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.5, ls="--")
_ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 1.5)
_ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)
_ax.set_aspect("equal")
_ax.grid(True, ls=":", alpha=0.5)
_ax.set_xlabel("x")
_ax.set_ylabel("y")
_ax.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=9)
_fig
```
